summary: Frontend-only testing of LTCT & T2C feature additions on the Vite+Bun 3-style Rubik's cube trainer. All 6 requested feature areas verified via Playwright against the preview URL. Bracket-format labels, single-face cube-net highlighting (3 stickers glow, 51 dimmed), LTCT/T2C config selectors, filtering by case type, localStorage persistence, and Corners/Edges/Hint/manual-validate regressions all work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is large; buildCase()/settings persistence/SubsetModal could be extracted into modules to keep files <700 lines.

Consider adding a data-testid on individual sticker cells (e.g. data-testid='sticker-{index}' and data-highlighted='true|false') to make automated 'exactly 3 glowing stickers' assertions trivial instead of opacity-based heuristics.
seed_data_creation: None (tests only mutated localStorage key bld3style_settings_v1 during the run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified findings: (1) Header MORE > 'LTCT & T2C' (data-testid=mode-ltct) switches mode; overline reads 'LTCT / T2C · SPEFFZ'. (2) letter-pair-display renders bracket format matching ^[A-Z]{2}\[[A-Z]\]$ (samples: CG[I], DK[M], CW[Q], DU[J], CU[S], CL[P], BE[J], AO[M]). (3) CubeNet single-face highlight: exactly 3 stickers at opacity=1 (bright), 51 at opacity<0.5 (dim). (4) Settings > Select case subset > MORE > 'LTCT & T2C' shows ltct-selectors with ltct-mode-ltct and ltct-mode-t2c, both data-active='true' by default. (5) Toggling T2C off writes localStorage bld3style_settings_v1.ltctModes=['ltct']; toggling both off yields ltctModes=[] and letter-pair-display shows '--'. (6) With LTCT-only active, all displayed labels start with buffer letter 'C'. (7) Space/tap on trainer-main increments hud-solved (0->1). (8) Hint (H) modal displays algorithm text for current case (data-testid=hint-modal, hint-pair, hint-close-btn, hint-style-select). (9) Corners/Edges modes return non-bracketed labels. Note: Backspace key only advances the case when focus is on the body (not while a modal/dropdown holds focus) - if a future test presses Backspace immediately after closing a modal, ensure focus is released (click trainer-main first).
